description: This source file defines the 'AgentRouter' class, which provides an organizational interface for managing agent reasoners and skills within a FastAPI-inspired framework. It includes methods for registering reasoners and skills, and features automatic delegation of undefined attributes to an attached 'Agent' instance, facilitating modular and flexible agent configuration.

classes.name: AgentRouter
classes.description: Provides methods for registering reasoners and skills, attaching to an agent, and delegation of method calls. Supports path and tag management for agent components.

methods.name: __init__(self, prefix: str = "", tags: Optional[List[str]] = None)
methods.description: Initializes the AgentRouter with optional prefix and tags; sets up internal storage for reasoners, skills, and tracked functions.

methods.name: Callable[[Callable],Callable] reasoner( self, path: Optional[str] = None, *, tags: Optional[List[str]] = None, **kwargs: Any, )
methods.description: Decorator that stores a reasoner function for later registration; supports optional path and tags.

methods.name: Callable[[Callable],Callable] skill( self, tags: Optional[List[str]] = None, path: Optional[str] = None, **kwargs: Any, )
methods.description: Decorator that stores a skill function with optional path and tags.

methods.name: Any __getattr__(self, name: str)
methods.description: Automatic delegation to the attached 'Agent' instance for attributes or methods not explicitly defined in 'AgentRouter'.

methods.name: "Agent" app(self)
methods.description: Property to access the underlying 'Agent' instance, raises error if not attached.

methods.name: Optional[str] _combine_path( self, default: Optional[str], custom: Optional[str], override_prefix: Optional[str] = None, )
methods.description: Generates a normalized API path for registered functions based on default, custom path, and prefix.

methods.name: None _attach_agent(self, agent: "Agent")
methods.description: Internally attaches an 'Agent' instance to the router.

ctags.name: __init__
ctags.pattern: /^    def __init__(self, prefix: str = "", tags: Optional[List[str]] = None):$/

ctags.name: _combine_path
ctags.signature: ( self, default: Optional[str], custom: Optional[str], override_prefix: Optional[str] = None, )

ctags.name: reasoner
ctags.signature: ( self, path: Optional[str] = None, *, tags: Optional[List[str]] = None, **kwargs: Any, )

ctags.name: skill
ctags.signature: ( self, tags: Optional[List[str]] = None, path: Optional[str] = None, **kwargs: Any, )

ctags.name: wrapper
ctags.pattern: /^            async def wrapper(*args: Any, **kw: Any) -> Any:$/
